description: Source code for Redis ziplist implementation, including functions for creating, resizing, inserting, deleting, and iterating over a memory-efficient doubly linked list structure used internally by Redis.

methods.name: ziplistNew
methods.description: Creates a new empty ziplist with initial header.

methods.name: __ziplistCascadeUpdate
methods.description: Handles cascading updates when prevlen fields need to grow or shrink.

methods.name: __ziplistDelete
methods.description: Deletes a number of entries starting at a given pointer.

methods.name: __ziplistInsert
methods.description: Inserts an element at a specified position.

methods.name: ziplistPush
methods.description: Pushes an element to the head or tail of the ziplist.

methods.name: ziplistIndex
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given index, supporting negative indices.

methods.name: ziplistNext
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next element in the list.

methods.name: ziplistPrev
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the previous element in the list.

methods.name: ziplistGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an element, either as string or integer.

methods.name: ziplistDelete
methods.description: Deletes a single element at a given position.

methods.name: ziplistDeleteRange
methods.description: Deletes a range of elements starting at a given index.

methods.name: ziplistCompare
methods.description: Compares a ziplist entry with a string.

methods.name: ziplistFind
methods.description: Finds an entry matching a string, with optional skipping.

methods.name: ziplistLen
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the ziplist.

methods.name: ziplistBlobLen
methods.description: Returns the total size in bytes of the ziplist blob.

methods.name: ziplistRepr
methods.description: Prints a human-readable representation of the ziplist for debugging.
